description: FullPivLU and ColPivQR of every shape, LBLT 1..6: factors, permutations, solve, inverse, determinant, rank of rank-deficient inputs (WP 8.5-P15)

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: full_piv_lu1
ops.doc: a.full_piv_lu(): (lu 1x1 packed, p = P [0..1), q = Q [0..1) as permuted index vectors), well-conditioned a
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: full_piv_lu1_solve
ops.doc: a.full_piv_lu().solve(&b).unwrap()
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: full_piv_lu1_inverse
ops.doc: a.full_piv_lu().try_inverse().unwrap()
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)
